title: Starfighter Rebel Crossbones Decal
message: Mark your ride like a starfighter pilot. The Star Wars Starfighter Rebel Crossbones decal is up on eBay now.

title: Introducing Clone Defense
message: One Jedi. An endless droid assault. Deflect blaster fire with your saber, spend the Force to hold the line, and push the war across worlds.

title: Sort the Comics!
message: You can now see the latest HyperPanels OR the most popular panels! See options at the top of the comic list.

title: Your focus determines your reality
message: Green letters now carry over to your next guess automatically in SWordle, and typing skips right past them. Tap a green box to override it. On by default — switch it off in Settings if you'd rather do it the old-fashioned way.

title: Star Wars: Legacy of Vader Book 1
message: Review of Star Wars: Legacy of Vader book 1. Kylo Ren wrestles with who he is and sets out to destroy his past, starting with his grandfather Darth Vader.

title: We're back!
message: Sorry about that, we ran out of words! Kriff...

title: The honor!
message: A couple of other sites have ripped off SWordle, and it's such an honor. (Good Jedi answer, amiright?) The original lives at wordle.starwars.guide — make sure that's where you're playing.

title: We were running low...
message: We were running low on words! We dove back into Wookieepedia and found more than 100 new words! We also shuffled them all up, so words from earlier matches are now possible to be the winning words again.

title: Hints are now available!
message: After your third guess, you can now see a hint! In the top left you'll see a green icon appear, press that, and then press Show Hint to see your hint. Don't worry, this hint will still be vague, but should help you narrow in on what the word is. Using a hint will be tracked in your stats.

title: View the word list
message: The entire word list is now available for you to review, and search. Go to the word list here.
